name: Benue
summary: Nigeria's agricultural heartland — yams, soybeans, rice, citrus — and one of the states most affected by farmer-herder conflict and displacement, making resettlement and agro-industrial recovery central to NCDC's work here.
activities: Resettlement and rehabilitation support for displaced farming communities
Agro-industrial cluster and rural feeder-road planning
Erosion and flood-control assessments along the Benue valley

name: Kogi
summary: Where the Niger meets the Benue. Rich in coal, iron ore and limestone, with Ajaokuta at its centre — solid-minerals beneficiation and flood resilience anchor the Commission's agenda in Kogi.
activities: Support for agro-processing along the confluence corridor

name: Kwara
summary: A gateway between the North and South-West with growing agribusiness, ICT and education sectors — NCDC's focus here is youth innovation, human capital and cross-regional trade infrastructure.
activities: Youth digital-skills and innovation hub development

name: Nasarawa
summary: Host of the Commission's headquarters in Lafia and one of Nigeria's richest solid-minerals belts — lithium, barite, tin — with fast-growing peri-urban corridors serving the FCT.
activities: Responsible-mining cooperatives with state government and federal ministry

name: Niger
summary: Nigeria's largest state by landmass, home to the Kainji, Jebba and Shiroro hydropower dams — energy, irrigation and the rehabilitation of communities affected by banditry define NCDC's priorities.
activities: Rehabilitation and reconstruction planning for conflict-affected communities

name: Plateau
summary: The tin city and highland agriculture powerhouse. Restoring peace, resettling displaced communities and reviving tourism and mining value chains are at the core of the Commission's Plateau agenda.
activities: Post-conflict resettlement and reconstruction of communities

name: Federal Capital Territory
summary: The nation's capital sits within the North Central zone. NCDC coordinates with the FCT Administration on satellite-town infrastructure, rural area councils and regional integration.
activities: Regional transport integration with FCT Administration
Liaison with federal ministries and development partners
